name: Risley turret: J1 and J2 as two overlapping rings on top of the scapula
verdict: worth a GPU sweep as a SUBTYPE of the spherical 3R: a flat J1 ring bearing on the scapula top cap (93 % in band) + O20 hubs at J2/J3, honest gap 63.17 vs the champion's 68.93 (70.27 on the same kit checks); the spec's two-ring turret itself is dead (best 75.79, ring 2 floats 80-150 mm)
